outcome: Changes in midwifery services over time
cohort: Women receiving midwifery care at a tertiary care hospital
finding: Despite small increases in interventions like epidurals, inductions, and cesarean births, midwives demonstrated a commitment to safe, evidence-based, woman-centered care within a collaborative practice model.
mod_finding: Midwives have a commitment to providing safe, evidenced-based, woman-centered care within a collaborative practice model at a tertiary care center, with small increases in intervention practices over time.
